mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{type}, #{payload}, 'NEW', 0, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, type, payload, status, created_at FROM outbox WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{batchSize}
